issues.problem: Both tool calls in the candidate share the same id "call_a", while the following tool messages reference call_a and call_b.
issues.reason: Duplicate tool-call ids within one assistant message are invalid per the chat-completions schema and break id-based correlation with tool result messages. issues.suggestion: Use a distinct id for the second call (or verify the comparator detects duplicate ids as a structural mismatch rather than silently deduplicating).
